summary: A pipeline-stages editor: four rows that reorder by grip or menu, each collapsing to a summary on a narrow screen and opening a name, kind and stale-days form.
use: Settings screens that edit an ordered list of records (stages, tags, loss reasons, quick replies) with inline fields.
spec: `<SortableList items={stages} getId={(s) => s.id} getLabel={(s) => s.name} onreorder={reorder} label="Pipeline stages">` owns the grip, the drag and the reorder menu
`async function reorder({ from, to }: SortableListReorder)` applies the move, saves it and restores `before` when the save fails
`<EditableRow label={stage.name}>` holds the `TextField`, `Select` and `NumberField` and collapses when its own width is narrow
